primitives.name: Help Event Entropy Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters Users need to find value in 10 seconds.
primitives.assumptions: Information content of help events must be bounded by 10-second cognitive window.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{\text{comprehend}} > 10s, event entropy exceeds acceptable threshold.

layer2.mapping: Entropy of help event data stream maps to mutual information between user intent and help delivery mechanism in GSI's belief network.

primitives.name: Trust-Safe Media Path
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE is proprietary and complex, so every major item needs an immediate explanation, a next action, and a trust-safe media or visual path.
primitives.assumptions: Media path must satisfy trust and actionability constraints simultaneously.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{\text{trust}} < 0.5, media fails to meet safety criteria.

layer2.mapping: Trust-safe media path is derived from GSE's state transition kernel conditioned on user trust score and action readiness.
layer2.telemetry: User engagement rate with media elements in help flow.

primitives.name: Contextual Help Coverage
primitives.verbatim_quote: reason_not_duplicate: Help analytics event taxonomy focuses on 10-second comprehension and contextual help coverage, not generic help docs.
primitives.assumptions: Coverage is defined as proportion of user context resolved within T_{\text{context}}.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_{\text{coverage}} < 90%, coverage is insufficient for 10s comprehension.

layer2.mapping: Contextual coverage maps to GSI's semantic alignment between help event and user query space.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of help items achieving full contextual resolution within 10s.
